parts.name: body shell

physics.Basic_description: The main orange-painted body of the lock, octagonal in front view with a matte finish.
physics.Functional_description: Houses the internal locking mechanism and combination dials.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the sides of the body firmly to stabilize the lock while manipulating the shackle or dials.
physics.reason: Die-cast metal shells are thin-walled enclosures containing air and internal mechanisms, not solid blocks.

parts.description: The main orange-painted body of the lock, octagonal in front view with a matte finish.
parts.function: Houses the internal locking mechanism and combination dials.

parts.name: faceplate

physics.Basic_description: Small green accents or pads located at the corners or edges of the body face.
physics.Functional_description: Likely serves as a protective bumper or decorative accent on the faceplate.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and flush to be grasped independently; avoid gripping here to prevent slippage.
physics.reason: Small plastic inserts or pads are typically solid molded components.

parts.description: Small green accents or pads located at the corners or edges of the body face.
parts.function: Likely serves as a protective bumper or decorative accent on the faceplate.

parts.name: dial frame

physics.Basic_description: Thin blue metallic strips framing the dial area on the side of the lock body.
physics.Functional_description: Provides structural support and alignment for the rotating combination dials.
physics.Grasped_description: Not suitable for grasping; too thin and recessed.
physics.reason: Thin metal strips acting as frames are effectively solid relative to their scale.

parts.description: Thin blue metallic strips framing the dial area on the side of the lock body.
parts.function: Provides structural support and alignment for the rotating combination dials.

parts.name: rivets

physics.Basic_description: Tiny yellow/gold dots visible on the side edges, representing fasteners.
physics.Functional_description: Secures the body halves or internal plates together.
physics.Grasped_description: Impossible to grasp individually due to size.
physics.reason: Rivets are solid metal pins.

parts.description: Tiny yellow/gold dots visible on the side edges, representing fasteners.
parts.function: Secures the body halves or internal plates together.

parts.name: dial axles

physics.Basic_description: Small orange protrusions or centers associated with the dial mechanism.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as the central pivot point for the combination wheels to rotate around.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and internal to grasp.
physics.reason: Axles must be solid to transmit torque and support rotation.

parts.description: Small orange protrusions or centers associated with the dial mechanism.
parts.function: Acts as the central pivot point for the combination wheels to rotate around.

parts.name: shackle bar

physics.Basic_description: The U-shaped silver/white bar extending from the top of the lock body.
physics.Functional_description: The locking element that passes through the hasp or chain to secure the object.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the vertical leg of the shackle to pull it open or closed once unlocked.
physics.reason: Shackles are solid hardened steel rods designed to resist cutting and pulling forces.

parts.description: The U-shaped silver/white bar extending from the top of the lock body.
parts.function: The locking element that passes through the hasp or chain to secure the object.

parts.name: dial 1 wheel

physics.Basic_description: The first cyan-colored rotating wheel on the side of the lock.
physics.Functional_description: Rotates to select the first digit of the combination code.
physics.Grasped_description: Pinch the edge of the wheel with fingertips or narrow grippers to rotate it.
physics.reason: Combination wheels are typically thin stamped or cast rings/shells, not solid cylinders.

parts.description: The first cyan-colored rotating wheel on the side of the lock.
parts.function: Rotates to select the first digit of the combination code.

parts.name: dial 1 band

physics.Basic_description: A magenta strip or band associated with the first dial, likely indicating numbers.
physics.Functional_description: Displays the numerical digits for the combination setting.
physics.Grasped_description: Part of the dial assembly; grasping the band effectively grasps the wheel.
physics.reason: Thin plastic bands or printed layers are treated as solid sheets at this scale.

parts.description: A magenta strip or band associated with the first dial, likely indicating numbers.
parts.function: Displays the numerical digits for the combination setting.

parts.name: dial 2 wheel

physics.Basic_description: The second pink-colored rotating wheel in the sequence.
physics.Functional_description: Rotates to select the second digit of the combination code.
physics.Grasped_description: Pinch the edge of the wheel to rotate it to the desired number.
physics.reason: Similar to dial 1, this is a thin-walled rotating ring.

parts.description: The second pink-colored rotating wheel in the sequence.
parts.function: Rotates to select the second digit of the combination code.

parts.name: dial 2 band

physics.Basic_description: A lime green strip associated with the second dial.
physics.Functional_description: Displays the numerical digits for the second combination setting.
physics.Grasped_description: Integral to the dial; manipulated by rotating the wheel.
physics.reason: Thin marking band treated as solid sheet.

parts.description: A lime green strip associated with the second dial.
parts.function: Displays the numerical digits for the second combination setting.

parts.name: dial 3 wheel

physics.Functional_description: Rotates to select the third digit of the combination code.
physics.Grasped_description: Pinch the edge to rotate and align the combination.
physics.reason: Thin-walled rotating ring structure.

parts.function: Rotates to select the third digit of the combination code.

parts.name: dial 3 band

physics.Basic_description: A brown strip associated with the third dial.
physics.Functional_description: Displays the numerical digits for the third combination setting.
physics.reason: Thin marking band treated as solid sheet.

parts.description: A brown strip associated with the third dial.
parts.function: Displays the numerical digits for the third combination setting.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained

simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)
